company.name: Pyypl
company.shortDescription: Pyypl (pronounced as “people”) enables digital payments for the approaching 1 billion smartphone users in the Middle East and Africa.
company.description: Pyypl is a financial service-based company. That exists because everyone in the digitalizing world should have a chance to use their money safer, faster, and smarter than cash. And are a pioneering Fintech company in our region, globally, and a passionate advocate of financial inclusion.

productsAndServices.description: A smartphone app providing access to digital financial services including money transfers, payments, and account management without requiring a bank account.
productsAndServices.name: Pyypl Digital Wallet App

productsAndServices.description: A prepaid Visa card linked to the Pyypl app for making online and in-store payments globally where Visa is accepted.
productsAndServices.name: Pyypl Prepaid Visa Card

productsAndServices.description: A service enabling users to send money instantly and securely to over 70 countries in multiple currencies via bank accounts, mobile wallets, or cash pickup.
productsAndServices.name: International Money Transfer Service

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables users to request payments from others via a simple link, facilitating easy receipt of funds within the app.
productsAndServices.name: Pyypl PayMe Link Payment Request

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $20,000,000, or 64.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $73,655,952 to $169,110,245, a 2.3x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
